description: This file defines the 'BaseDrawing' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, which serves as a base class for various drawable objects such as images or charts in a worksheet. It includes properties and methods for positioning, sizing, rotation, shadow effects, hyperlinks, and type information of the drawing object.

classes.name: BaseDrawing
classes.description: Base class for drawable objects in a worksheet (such as images), providing properties/methods for positioning, sizing, rotation, effects, and hyperlinks.

methods.name: getImageIndex
methods.description: Returns the unique index of the image/drawing object.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the drawing object.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Gets the name of the drawing object.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the drawing object.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Gets the description of the drawing object.

methods.name: setWorksheet
methods.description: Assigns the drawing to a worksheet, with optional override of existing assignment.

methods.name: getWorksheet
methods.description: Returns the worksheet to which the drawing belongs.

methods.name: setCoordinates
methods.description: Sets the cell coordinates where the drawing is anchored.

methods.name: getCoordinates
methods.description: Gets the cell coordinates of the anchor point.

methods.name: setOffsetX
methods.description: Sets the horizontal offset in pixels.

methods.name: getOffsetX
methods.description: Gets the horizontal offset in pixels.

methods.name: setOffsetY
methods.description: Sets the vertical offset in pixels.

methods.name: getOffsetY
methods.description: Gets the vertical offset in pixels.

methods.name: setCoordinates2
methods.description: Sets the second cell coordinates for two-cell anchoring.

methods.name: getCoordinates2
methods.description: Gets the second cell coordinates.

methods.name: setOffsetX2
methods.description: Sets the second horizontal offset.

methods.name: getOffsetX2
methods.description: Gets the second horizontal offset.

methods.name: setOffsetY2
methods.description: Sets the second vertical offset.

methods.name: getOffsetY2
methods.description: Gets the second vertical offset.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the image/drawing. Resizes height proportionally if enabled.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Gets the width of the image/drawing.

methods.name: setHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of the image/drawing. Resizes width proportionally if enabled.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Gets the height of the image/drawing.

methods.name: setResizeProportional
methods.description: Enables or disables proportional resizing.

methods.name: getResizeProportional
methods.description: Checks if proportional resizing is enabled.

methods.name: setWidthAndHeight
methods.description: Sets both width and height, resizing proportionally if enabled.

methods.name: setRotation
methods.description: Sets the rotation angle of the drawing in degrees.

methods.name: getRotation
methods.description: Gets the rotation angle.

methods.name: setShadow
methods.description: Sets the shadow effect.

methods.name: getShadow
methods.description: Gets the shadow effect.

methods.name: setHyperlink
methods.description: Sets the hyperlink associated with the image.

methods.name: getHyperlink
methods.description: Gets the hyperlink.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the image type.

methods.name: getImageWidth
methods.description: Returns the image width in pixels.

methods.name: getImageHeight
methods.description: Returns the image height in pixels.

methods.name: getEditAs
methods.description: Gets the editing mode ('absolute', 'oneCell', 'twoCell').

methods.name: setEditAs
methods.description: Sets the editing mode.

methods.name: validEditAs
methods.description: Checks if the current 'editAs' value is valid.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of the drawing object.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code for the drawing object based on its properties.
